title: Handcrafted Eco-Friendly Jute  Bag , Baskets
description: Meticulously handwoven over four hours of dedicated craftsmanship, this premium jute bag combines sustainable living with functional elegance. Built with sturdy natural fibers and quality certified standards, it is ideal for conscious everyday use as well as corporate gifting.
story: Each bag represents four hours of patient artisanal labor, transforming organic jute into durable, eco-friendly creations certified for premium quality.

title: Handcrafted Floral Textured Ceramic Vase
description: Elevate your home decor with this exquisitely handcrafted aesthetic pottery featuring intricate floral textures. Meticulously molded and detailed by skilled artisans, its warm organic finish adds an earthy charm to any living space. Perfect for displaying fresh garden flowers or as a standalone statement piece.
story: Rooted in generational pottery traditions, our master craftspeople hand-carve delicate floral motifs into raw clay to capture the eternal elegance of nature. Each creation carries the passion and heritage of traditional handmade artistry.

title: Authentic Hand-Painted Khurja Blue Pottery Vase
description: Expertly handcrafted by traditional master artisans. Features authentic craftsmanship derived from local techniques, combining traditional heritage with modern elegance: "Khurja ka authentic hand painted blue pottery vase hai, 100% natural clay aur glazed finish ke saath.".
story: Handcrafted in small artisan workshops preserving generations of ancestral Indian craft heritage and traditional artistry.

title: Handcrafted Mirror-Work Embroidered Tote Bag
description: A vibrant hand-embroidered cotton tote bag featuring traditional mirror work, intricate resham thread stitching, and sturdy handles.
story: Crafted by Sunita Devi in Jaipur using age-old Rajasthani mirror embroidery passed down through three generations.

title: Phulkari Hand-Embroidered Chanderi Silk Dupatta
description: Vibrant geometric floral threadwork dupatta embroidered using soft untwisted silk threads on rich Chanderi fabric.
story: Ranjit Singh trains 15 women in his Ludhiana village to keep traditional Punjabi Phulkari stitching alive.

title: Hand-Carved Sheesham Wood Brass Inlay Box
description: Sturdy Indian rosewood box featuring floral brass wire inlay work and natural wax finish.
story: Arjun Meena hand-carves each box using traditional Marwari chisels passed down from his grandfather.

title: Traditional Madhubani Folk Art Canvas Wall Painting
description: Hand-painted Madhubani artwork depicting peacocks and lotus flowers created using natural twigs and organic pigments.
story: Fatima Sheikh paints folk tales from Mithila using turmeric, indigo, and soot pigments.

title: Handmade Terracotta Tea Cup Set
description: A rustic set of hand-shaped terracotta tea cups fired using traditional pottery techniques.
story: Made by a family pottery cluster in Khurja, combining everyday utility with traditional clay craftsmanship.

title: Dokra Brass Tribal Pendant Necklace
description: A handcrafted brass pendant inspired by traditional Dokra metal casting and tribal motifs.
story: Created by metal artisans who shape each piece with the lost-wax tradition and hand-finish every pendant.

title: Eco-Friendly Handwoven Jute Storage Basket
description: A strong handwoven jute basket for home storage, gifting and sustainable everyday living.
story: Women artisans weave natural jute into durable household products using low-waste handcraft methods.

title: Block-Printed Cotton Table Runner
description: Hand block-printed cotton table runner with heritage floral motifs for contemporary homes.
story: Printed by hand using carved wooden blocks and small-batch dyes in a Rajasthan craft cluster.

title: Hand-Painted Blue Pottery Serving Bowl
description: A blue pottery bowl hand-painted with floral motifs, suitable for gifting and decorative serving.
story: Each bowl is painted and glazed individually by a Jaipur pottery artisan.

title: Minimal Sheesham Wood Desk Organizer
description: A hand-finished wooden desk organizer designed for clean modern workspaces.
story: Carved from responsibly sourced sheesham by a small Jodhpur workshop.

title: Madhubani Hand-Painted Bookmark Gift Set
description: A compact set of Madhubani hand-painted bookmarks for affordable heritage gifting.
story: Painted by women artists using fine linework inspired by Mithila folk traditions.
